approvalBasis: Human initially instructed the PlotPickle workstream to continue from the Phase 2 review gate, then clarified that the SVG boards should not be treated as implementable visual targets.
visualPrecedent: existing Matrix implementation and real Matrix screenshots, with Dashboard as the sole locked baseline
generationNotes: Two initial image-generator attempts were rejected before repository admission because they drifted into the retired bronze/stone visual language and combined multiple board scopes.
The admitted SVGs use current Skin V1 token roles and remain useful as conceptual studies.
Human follow-up review determined that the SVG compositions should not be implemented as visual targets.
The SVGs remain preserved for design history but are superseded by the existing Matrix implementation and real Matrix screenshots as visual precedent.
